//Marker: The clamped marker between a lost bandit fight and the theft (Documentation/Research/HarshWilds/bandits.md section 4.3 and DECISION 4; the CLAUDE.md 'NPC Errand Stat Design' clamped-marker rule). Range 0 to 1 and no rate, so a second write while it is already 1 changes nothing and one loss can never be counted twice. Written ONLY by the PlayerDemoralizedEffects block of Encounter/hw_encounter_bandit.json (+1). Read ONLY by SelfTriggeredAction/hw_tgr_bandit_theft.json, whose action sets it back to 0 in the same step that raises the theft (-1), and whose RepeatOptions 2 (ResetWhenOutOfRange) re-arms only once it has gone back to 0. So one loss is exactly one theft, and a save made with it at 1 thieves once on load, never twice.

Description.DefaultText: Hidden 0/1 marker: 1 between losing a fight to bandits and their going through your pack.
